title: Marubatsu 2.0

summary.en: Tic-tac-toe with one rule changed — a 4×4 board, two marks a turn — playable solo, against an AI, or online with a second phone.
summary.jp: ○×を一部変え、4×4・1 手 2 個置き。1 台でも AI 相手でも、2 台でも遊べる。

mine: Co-invented the 4×4, two-marks-per-turn rule with his son over hundreds of rounds on paper and notes apps
Built one board that works face-to-face, against an AI opponent, and online
Built the Gemini-first AI opponent with a local-search fallback across 4 difficulty levels
Wrote the QR/code pairing, presence, and rejoin logic that became the starting point for the separate Snap Pair library

challenge.en: Classic 3×3 tic-tac-toe is solved: two careful players always draw. Online versions then bury a two-minute game under accounts and lobbies. Marubatsu had to stay simple enough to play on paper, give a parent and a child something real to fight over, and move to a second phone without a sign-up.
challenge.jp: 3×3 の○×は解けてしまっていて、慎重に指せば必ず引き分けになる。オンライン版になると、2 分で終わる遊びがアカウントとロビーに埋もれる。紙でも遊べる単純さを保ったまま、親子で本気で競えて、登録なしで 2 台目のスマホへ移れること。それが条件だった。

solution.en: One board works in every setting: pass-and-play on one phone, an AI opponent at four levels from Easy to Impossible, or online with a second phone through a QR code or a six-character room code. The AI asks Gemini first and hands over to an on-device search when Gemini is unavailable, so a match never stalls.
solution.jp: 1 枚の盤を、どの遊び方でも同じように使えるようにした。1 台を交代で指す。Easy から Impossible まで 4 段階の AI と指す。QR か 6 文字のルームコードで、2 台目のスマホとオンライン対戦する。AI はまず Gemini に聞き、使えないときは端末内の探索が代わりに指すので、対局が止まらない。

_notes: Thumbnail, still and preview come from the 2026-09 screen recordings (assets/marubatsu/masters/).

cardLine.en: 4×4 tic-tac-toe you can play across phones — or against a bot.
cardLine.jp: 4×4 まるばつ。スマホ同士でも、ボット相手でも。

oneLiner.en: Tic-tac-toe with one rule changed — a 4×4 board, two marks a turn — on one phone, across two, or against an AI.
oneLiner.jp: ○×のルールを一つだけ変えた。4×4 の盤に、1 手で 2 つ置く。1 台でも、2 台でも、AI 相手でも遊べる。
